english_title: Recognising and Responding to Choosing a Simple Food
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: food & drink — choosing a simple food
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to choosing a simple food; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan offers Ms Olivia a choice between a sandwich and salad.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan mời chị Olivia chọn giữa bánh sandwich và salad.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Olivia, would you like a sandwich or salad?
turns.vietnamese: Olivia này, chị muốn bánh sandwich hay salad?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.vietnamese: Bánh sandwich nhé. Có ngay đây.
